status: TEST 0.3.249: Fix the Organizer navigation heading width mismatch. Both Resource Type and Group Directory headings keep the shared .tle-organizer-pane-title rule and fill the full content width of their own panes, aligning both left and right edges. The root cause was the Group Directory heading being nested inside a horizontal flex wrapper and shrinking to its text width. The fix adds width:100%, min-width:0 and border-box sizing to the shared desktop rule only. No fixed width for the group heading, no three-column ratio change, and no new visual treatment; both headings continue inheriting standoutHeader and the active SillyTavern theme. Added source regression checks and a browser acceptance check comparing each title width to its pane content width. Automated checks pending; ST/TT visual acceptance remains pending.
